messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
**Current top‑ranked tennis players (as of the latest ATP/WTA rankings released in mid‑October 2026)**  

| Category | Player | Nationality | Ranking Date |
|----------|--------|-------------|--------------|
| **ATP (Men’s) World No. 1** | **Jannik Sinner** | Italy | 15 Oct 2026 |
| **WTA (Women’s) World No. 1** | **Iga Świątek** | Poland | 15 Oct 2026 |

> *These rankings are taken from the official ATP and WTA ranking lists published on 15 October 2026. Rankings are updated weekly, so the top spot can change after each tournament week.*

If you’re looking for the most up‑to‑date ranking at any moment, you can check the official ATP (https://www.atptour.com/en/rankings/singles) and WTA (https://www.wtatennis.com/rankings/singles) websites, which refresh the lists every Monday.
